physics-killer-09.title: Work and Mechanical Energy Conservation
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the principles of Work and Mechanical Energy Conservation and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-09.material: In the fusion reaction $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ the particle masses are $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Take the energy equivalent of $1\,\mathrm{u}$ to be $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ and ignore the kinetic energies of the particles before the reaction. Which option correctly gives, in order, the energy $E$ released in this reaction and the kinetic energy of the neutron, assuming the produced $\mathrm{^4He}$ and neutron have momenta of equal magnitude and a mass ratio of $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: In the fusion reaction $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ the particle masses are $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Take the energy equivalent of $1\,\mathrm{u}$ to be $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ and ignore the kinetic energies of the particles before the reaction. Which option correctly gives, in order, the energy $E$ released in this reaction and the kinetic energy of the neutron, assuming the produced $\mathrm{^4He}$ and neutron have momenta of equal magnitude and a mass ratio of $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$, so $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. After the reaction the two particles have equal momentum magnitudes, so $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ and $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Hence $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$ and $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Inverting the mass dependence gives $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (option 2), halving the energy gives option 3, and miscalculating $\Delta m$ as $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ gives option 4.
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
